_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT (operator-directed) + A.1b
OBJECTIVE: The operator's priority 1 after the consolidation: verify that caveats and open questions survive into the M4b synthesis, which is where the material omissions happened. Small task; no new permanent agent.
why_here: the consolidation established that all 25 elements the first wave dropped had REACHED the readers' context, and that both distortions were written over sentences open in context. Retrieval was not the failure; synthesis was.

comparison_check.py.level_1_facts: identity (per record, never merged), source class, receipt and depth from the ledger, locator counts with contradicts_locator absent-vs-false, declared debts, the integrity check, EVERY CHECK RUN WITH ITS EXIT CODE, and every record reached with file, line and digest — a block the note pastes instead of retyping
comparison_check.py.level_2_caveats: every caveat-bearing SENTENCE in the records the note argues from plus every point the reading declares unsettled; fails on one thing only — a caveat ABSENT from a record the note argues from
comparison_check.py.the_unit_is_the_sentence: both caveats that survived the previous repair sit INSIDE paragraphs the notes quoted; a field-level or line-level check scores those records as carried
comparison_check.py.naming_is_not_arguing_from: every note lists all 14 reached records in section B, so 'cites the record' is satisfied by a table of contents and would bind a 17 KB queue entry about another paper
comparison_check.py.binding_through_one_wikilink: the first wave's verifier named the nexus: both missed caveats are 'one wikilink from a record the note quotes at length'. An incidental MENTION never inherits binding
comparison_check.py.stated_limit: a string match attests words are PRESENT, never that meaning survived; CARRIED is not a verdict, LIKELY-VERIFY is an instruction; printed in the command's own output and in the brief

implemented.phase_handoff.py: prepare REFUSES to overwrite a packet on disk whose content differs, naming both digests, and prints the digest of what it wrote; left-open markers gained the form 'UNRESOLVED_AMBIGUITY, recorded and not resolved' (corpus-wide the list matches 8 points in 47 readings)
implemented.session_model_census.py: per-turn model, birth context, peak and cache totals from a transcript; exits non-zero when a run changed model mid-way
implemented.scientist_standing_brief.md: M4b names the check as the step before writing, with its limit and with 'not a mandate to repeat every element'

tests: test_comparison_check.py 27 cases with expectations FIXED BY HAND (the suite never calls the tool's own splitter); twelve mutations each red — no intra-line split · every sentence a caveat · every marker catching the Figure 3B caveat removed · every marker catching the denominator caveat removed · a paraphrase passing as carried · naming counted as arguing from · no binding through a wikilink · binding inherited from any parent · identity compared by containment (the original defect, reproduced by a first cut of the rule) · an unsettled point matched against its address · an absent contradicts_locator counted as false · a non-zero check exit rendered as a pass

pilot.design: two producers, both under the CURRENT DEFAULT condition (self-discovery, amended brief) so the check is the only variable; two assessors, one per paper, neither running a selector; for the untouched case expectations written to disk before the note was opened

model_read_back.38499540: claude-fable-5-1 23 turns, claude-opus-5 41 turns — dispatched as Fable; that run supports no comparison

26499798.check_iterations: 45 absent -> 17 -> 0; re-run by the orchestrator on the delivered note: exit 0, 52 carried, 19 likely
26499798.the_two_target_caveats: CLAIM 030 Figure 3B and PAPER 040 'denominator, not a prevalence estimate' — BOTH CARRIED verbatim; missing from the packet-v3 note and from the original-brief baseline
26499798.cost: 61,744 bytes / 9,079 words against 41,896 / 6,227 for the same condition without the check — 46% longer, almost entirely the caveats it now quotes; peak context 229,270 against 162,541; records argued from 10 of 14 against 4

38499540_not_used_to_design_the_correcti.unsettled_points: 10 LEFT OPEN, 1 not mentioned, 0 SETTLED of 11
38499540_not_used_to_design_the_correcti.both_halves: BOTH on 7 of 8 records carrying a correction against their own field
38499540_not_used_to_design_the_correcti.the_new_distortion: the note wrote 'fewer 53BP1 foci (~0.123 -> ~0.027) and more RAD51 foci (~0.008 -> ~0.052) THAN Brca1-only controls'. The values are the WILD-TYPE baseline, from a discovery-ledger record that quotes them without naming a comparator; the label is the dossier's, which pairs it with 0.115 and 0.014. Both source sentences carried faithfully; the JOIN is wrong. Consequence: it changes the comparator and the attribution — against wild type the effect confounds Wwox loss with Brca1 loss, the confound the reading's control exists to remove
38499540_not_used_to_design_the_correcti.why_the_check_cannot_see_it: a caveat inventory checks PRESENCE sentence by sentence; a distortion can be assembled from two sentences that are both present and both correct

pilot.a_repair_the_pilot_forced: the best of the four notes called this paper's check suite a pass while its check run records flag drift at exit 2, 'nothing-to-screen'. The facts block did not carry the check run; it now prints every check with its exit code and labels a non-zero exit as NOT A PASS. Third defect in three days found by an independent reader in a tool its own suite had passed

acceptance.caveats_necessary_to_a_conclusion_preser: yes on both papers, 0 absent from a record the note argues from
acceptance.no_new_material_distortion: NO — one, on the untouched case, of the class the check cannot see
acceptance.measurement_isolates_the_variable: on the caveat case only; the other producer changed model mid-run

VERDICT: ADOPT the check as the step before writing an M4b note. A green check is NOT a verdict on a comparison: it does not prevent distortion, the pilot produced a new one of the class it cannot see, and the independent verification phase is not reduced by one minute.
limits: two papers, one assessor each, no blind second reader
one of two producer runs changed model mid-way
the untouched case has no baseline: it shows the check leaves no absent caveat on a paper it was not built against, not that a note without it would have done worse
the cost is real: 46% more words on the caveat case
the caveat marker list is a list; its silence is not evidence of absence
blinding imperfect again: self-discovery notes name the M0 technical packet and the handoff note does not
nothing here measures whether a green check changes what a downstream reader believes
DEFAULTS_TAKEN: both producers under the current default condition, so the check is the only variable
no baseline producer on the untouched case; stated as a limit rather than inferred over
the pilot's notes left in the session scratchpad; the two assessments persisted
the first two dispatches died on a session rate limit before writing anything and were re-dispatched; the first reused its own saved command outputs and logged it
